SELECT br.user_id AS userId, MAX(br.username) AS username, COUNT(*) AS totalBattles, SUM(CASE WHEN br.is_winner = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS winCount, SUM(CASE WHEN br.is_winner = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loseCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN br.is_winner = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS winRate, COALESCE(SUM(br.submit_count), 0) AS totalSubmitCount, ROUND(AVG(br.battle_time)) AS avgBattleTime, MAX(ur.hist_rating) AS rating FROM battle_record br LEFT JOIN user_record ur ON ur.uid = br.user_id WHERE br.is_excluded = 0
AND br.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%')
GROUP BY br.user_id ORDER BY winCount DESC, winRate DESC, totalBattles DESC, username ASC
